latest.title: Your Model Isn't on Bedrock Yet. Here's How to Self-Host It on AWS Today

latest.title: Weekend Agent Challenge: Opportunity Finder Agent
latest.description: I built an AI-powered Opportunity Finder Agent using AWS that automatically runs every day to generate personalized reports with internships, scholarships, certifications, and career opportunities. The project uses Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, EventBridge Scheduler, and Amazon S3 to create an always-on workflow.

latest.title: How I Built a Serverless CFP Agent on AWS
latest.description: I kept missing good Call for Papers (CFPs) because the deadlines are scattered everywhere and I could never remember what I'd already seen. So I built an agent that runs on AWS, checks the feeds every morning, ranks each CFP against my speaker profile with a model on Bedrock, and drops the good ones in Slack. Here's how it's wired together with Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock, EventBridge, and S3, why I picked each piece, and how it runs every day for next to nothing.
